bio: With the hard work of hostess Lissa and chef Kaj, the restaurant at Holsterhof camping farm has gradually evolved into a sought-after culinary destination, set in a modern, light-filled space surrounded by lush greenery. The service is relaxed and friendly. The chef is an expert sauce maker who creates daring combinations on the plate, without making things overly complicated. His exquisite red curry with coconut milk adds depth of flavour to the tender quail leg with black lentils. Working with two set menus, he consistently surprises with subtle nuances....
